title: Deeper/broader Aetheris STEP consumer and kernel-route refresh
mode: primary-source release/documentation review and local plan reconciliation
scope: Revisit the historical Aetheris candidate disposition after Preview 3 appeared
Separate bounded STEP AP242 import from DWG/DXF/SAT/SAB parsing and AcDs ownership
Check platform, source-lineage, kernel-independence, and license constraints
Add only a conditional composed-checkpoint evaluation recipe

method.kind: Read-only review of project README, release notes, supported-feature matrix, license, and existing local research plan
method.limitations: Aetheris sources are project-authored and mostly on mutable master. The exact Preview 3 source commit, release archive/checksum, dependency graph, STEP reader implementation, and kernel lineage were not resolved or audited. No runtime or geometry control was exercised.

sources.revision: Preview 3 release claims and mutable master documentation reviewed 2026-10-18; exact source commit not pinned
sources.observed: Preview 3 documents bounded single-body STEP AP242 import/export and parser-backed sphere/cone/torus routes. The support matrix excludes general containment and multi-root bodies from native-part promises; release notes identify imported-containment and source-unit-preservation limitations. The release bundle is qualified only for Windows x64. The project describes a .NET kernel but this pass did not establish implementation/dependency independence from OCCT. No DWG, DXF, SAT, SAB, or AcDs input route was established.

Repository identifies AGPL-3.0 and separate third-party asset provenance. This pass did not inspect the bundled assets or offer legal advice. No code, package, release binary, or test model was acquired.

assessment.planImpact: Supersedes the older statement that Aetheris had no relevant reader by adding a conditional STEP-consumer candidate for an already-planned composed checkpoint. It remains unqualified and does not fill DWG/DXF, ACIS/AcDs, native FreeCAD, or independent-kernel evidence gaps. No implementation queue or validation cadence change.

implementationReadyChecks: Do not install/build Aetheris during a normal implementation slice; consider it only if a specific existing composed semantic-evidence cell needs a STEP consumer.
Pin Preview 3 archive checksum, source commit, runtime, invocation, and exact STEP profile; audit source/dependencies before calling it an independent kernel.
Use only a locally authored asymmetric single-body control and explicit units/transforms; do not use Aetheris or its corpus as a source-DWG/ACIS fixture.
Require documented diagnostics and independent analytic expectations; imported source-unit or containment ambiguity is non-passing until resolved.
Keep parser, producer, STEP artifact, kernel, AcDs owner join, native FreeCAD, and platform qualification as separate evidence cells.
Do not copy/vendor code or add an Aetheris dependency; do not promote J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, or J295 from documentation alone.
